note: Hacker News stories matching security terms, from the Algolia HN Search API.
title: Hacker News security stories (Algolia)
description: Stories whose title or link matches security terms (CVE, vulnerability, ransomware, exploit, zero-day, breach). A CVE id written in the title or link becomes a 'mentions' participant, so a discussion can be joined to the catalog entry for the same CVE without guessing.

sources.license: Hacker News content under its terms; public API
sources.known_at_rule: The story's creation time; points and comments are known when they were fetched.
